headline: Egyptian Real Estate Platform Targets Rapid Website Creation for Brokers
summary: The Official Egyptian Real Estate Platform launched a digital system allowing property developers and brokers to build branded websites within five minutes to expand international marketing.
why: Proptech innovations aiming to digitize listings and customer management can lower operational overhead for real estate intermediaries.

impacts.name: Real Estate
impacts.why: Digital tools streamline marketing for local real estate agents and developers.
